description: cvrt-lang 0.10.0+: what a cleanup would remove of the old language plugin's data (GET /migrate/{source}/cleanup): tables, options, meta, terms, cron hooks (names and counts, never values), unknown names that are only listed, blockers, backup_dir readiness and the `confirm` token (valid 30 min, bound to this exact plan). Writes nothing. Order for a cleanup: (1) fort_backup_create, (2) fort_job_get until the job is completed, (3) lang_migrate_cleanup_plan (a fresh token, after the backup), (4) lang_migrate_cleanup_apply with confirm and the backup's job id. WP-CLI: `wp cvrt-lang migrate <source> cleanup --apply --confirm=<token>`.

source.description: Import source: wpml or polylang (the plugin the site is moving away from)

name: lang_migrate_cleanup_plan
